answer: Charge a nonrefundable entry bond that only vests after a willow of consecutive peer-sealed epochs, so a new key cannot harvest influence in one season. Each claim is passed through a prism of independent checks—paid fee, unique work, surviving audits—and any missing facet fails the whole. A public mirror of that history is compared against the agent's current vote request; mismatch or a copied record from a sibling key zeros the weight.
